arms.utr_snapshot_sg: existing snapshot actor and ordinary PPO under fixed UTR exposure
arms.tatg_cetm_utr: CETM temporal actor, chronological actor replay and unchanged snapshot critic under the same fixed UTR exposure
arms.tatg_snapshot_gru_utr: capacity-matched current-snapshot GRU temporal-actor control under the same fixed UTR exposure
arms.tatg_zero_residual_utr: capacity-matched zero-residual CETM temporal-actor control under the same fixed UTR exposure

training.actor_information: current legal actor tensors plus frozen local CETM state only for TATG arms
training.critic: existing architecturally unchanged centralized snapshot critic
training.exposure: fixed UTR; identical reset-time topology distribution per matched seed across all arms
training.sampler: no DRTP, EGTR, adaptive sampler, selector, gate or evaluation input

ppo.actor: ordinary clipped PPO plus entropy; full chronological [time, environment] replay for every temporal-actor epoch

training.runtime: strict actor/critic/optimizer/environment/RNG checkpoint state; diagnostic milestones are never selected by return

primary_analysis.primary_metric: mean non-nominal success across fixed development conditions
primary_analysis.comparison: paired CETM minus UTR on identical training seed and evaluation tape
primary_analysis.mechanism_disambiguation: CETM is compared descriptively with both equal-capacity temporal controls; no control result is pooled with CETM

required: CETM mean primary-metric delta versus UTR is strictly positive
at least two of three paired CETM-versus-UTR primary-metric deltas are nonnegative
CETM mean primary metric is not below either temporal control
CETM has no additional zero-success seed relative to paired UTR
CETM mean nominal-success delta versus UTR is at least -0.05
all trajectories, fixed endpoints and tape-integrity checks are complete
pilot_gate.rule: This one three-seed pilot is directional only. Any failure closes this TATG candidate without tuning. A pass permits only a separately authorized independent five-seed replication; it is not a performance or reliability claim.
